about: What the UI rebuild has rebuilt on the new presentation layer (docs/ui-rebuild/PLAN.md). smoke55 holds every file listed here to the new vocabulary: k- classes only, no legacy class name, no static inline style, no colour literal outside the tokens and themes layers, no CSS selecting [data-ui]. Each view listed must render without writing data (smoke56) and within its wrapper-depth budget (smoke55). Each milestone appends what it rebuilt; at M14 the lists cover everything.
